display.label: Output mode
display.description: 'array' packs all CUD events into a JSON array; 'single' produces one CUD event per record. Default: array

display.label: Tombstones enabled
display.description: Whether to pass through tombstone records. Default: true

display.label: Missing field behavior
display.description: How to react when a change event is missing a column that the mapping needs to build a CUD event (an id property, a foreign key, or the before/after image): 'fail' throws so the record is routed by the connector's error handling; 'warn' logs and skips the affected event (or the whole record when nothing can be built); 'ignore' skips silently. A node whose entire id key resolves to empty is never emitted regardless of this setting, because an unkeyed MERGE would collapse every row into a single node. Default: warn
